name: 7maps
description: Map of public MCP servers (software, not geography): find a tool for a job, check a server's status and estimated tool risk before connecting, and see what changed since approval. The first 20 route and road_conditions calls a day are not charged; then x402. Measured October 2026 on Opus 5.5: about 63% fewer tokens per verified answer about MCP servers; details: https://7it.co.il/7maps/plugin/
